name: soundcrate
description: SoundCloud MCP server for Claude: search tracks, build private playlists and sort them by BPM or Camelot key.
long_description: SoundCrate is a SoundCloud MCP server that connects Claude to your own SoundCloud account. Search tracks by genre, BPM or upload date (every result shows its key); get related tracks and artists; create private playlists; and analyze or reorder them by BPM or harmonic key (Camelot). Everything runs on your computer: your credentials stay in the system secret store and setup happens on a local page, never in the chat. After installing, ask Claude: "Help me set up SoundCrate". Requires a SoundCloud app, which needs a SoundCloud Artist Pro plan. Creating the app means accepting SoundCloud's API terms: section 03 forbids using API content as input to AI, and SoundCloud can revoke access without notice, so you use SoundCrate at your own responsibility. Not affiliated with SoundCloud.

go_plus.title: I have SoundCloud Go+
go_plus.description: Turn on if your SoundCloud account has Go+, so SoundCrate treats Go+ catalogue tracks as playable in full (label tracks usually are, with no guarantee for your region or rights). SoundCloud does not report this, so you have to tell it.

tools.name: setup_status
tools.description: Check whether SoundCrate is ready on this computer and, if not, get the exact next steps.

tools.name: start_setup
tools.description: Open SoundCrate's local setup page in the user's browser (served only on 127.0.0.1).

tools.name: search_tracks
tools.description: Search tracks by text and/or filters (genres, tags, BPM, duration, upload date).

tools.name: get_track
tools.description: Get one track by id or soundcloud.com URL.

tools.name: get_related_tracks
tools.description: Tracks related to a track (SoundCloud's recommendations).

tools.name: get_my_tracks
tools.description: Tracks from the user's account to inspire playlists.

tools.name: search_users
tools.description: Search artists, labels or DJs.

tools.name: get_related_artists
tools.description: Artists similar to a given one, according to SoundCloud.

tools.name: get_user_content
tools.description: Content from an artist, label or DJ.

tools.name: search_playlists
tools.description: Search PUBLIC playlists from any SoundCloud user (without tracks); it does not find the user's private playlists, use get_my_playlists for those.

tools.name: get_station
tools.description: A SoundCloud station (system playlist) with its tracks.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Check the session: user, plan and subscriptions SoundCloud reports for the account, and whether Go+ is declared.

tools.name: get_my_playlists
tools.description: The user's playlists, including private ones, without tracks.

tools.name: get_playlist
tools.description: A playlist with its tracks, the user's own or another user's public one.

tools.name: create_playlist
tools.description: Create a playlist.

tools.name: add_tracks_to_playlist
tools.description: Append tracks to the end of a playlist without removing existing ones (duplicates are ignored).

tools.name: remove_tracks_from_playlist
tools.description: Remove one or more tracks from a playlist in a single write.

tools.name: remove_track_from_playlist
tools.description: Remove one track from a playlist.

tools.name: replace_track_in_playlist
tools.description: Replace a track with another at the same position, e.g. a user upload with its official release.

tools.name: suggest_tracks
tools.description: Suggest tracks from 1 to 5 seeds: merges their related tracks, filters by BPM, duration and genre, and ranks them. Writes nothing.

tools.name: find_official_version
tools.description: For a track (especially a user upload), finds candidates for its official release: same title and artist, label, or same ISRC.

tools.name: analyze_playlist
tools.description: Summarize a playlist for planning: duration, BPM, Camelot keys, genres, duplicates, BPM jumps and harmonic clashes. Read-only.

tools.name: update_playlist
tools.description: Change a playlist's title, description, genre or tags and/or reorder its tracks by BPM, key, duration or release date. Never adds or removes tracks.
